item.title: What is GEO? — Complete Guide to Generative Engine Optimization
item.description: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is a methodology for optimizing brand content to be prioritized in AI answers based on LLM retrieval and generation mechanisms.

item.title: What is SEO? — Search Engine Optimization Fundamentals
item.description: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the practice of optimizing content quality, technical structure, and external references to improve organic rankings in traditional search engines.

item.title: What is RAG? — Retrieval-Augmented Generation Explained
item.description: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) is the mechanism where AI models retrieve relevant information from external knowledge bases in real-time to generate more accurate answers.

item.title: What is E-E-A-T? — Trust Mechanism in the AI Era
item.description: E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) is Google's gold standard for content quality, directly influencing whether AI chooses to cite your content.

item.title: What is LLMs.txt? — AI Crawler Infrastructure
item.description: LLMs.txt is a plain text file placed at the root of a website, serving as a "site manual" designed specifically for large language models.

item.title: What is Zero-Click Search? — The Logic Behind GEO
item.description: Zero-click search is the phenomenon where users get answers directly on the search results page without clicking any links, ending their search session immediately.

item.title: What is Schema? — Structured Data for AI Understanding
item.description: Schema structured data uses machine-readable "tags" to communicate page content structure to AI, creating "comprehension shortcuts" for AI systems.

item.title: What is Answer Assetization? — Let AI Advertise for You
item.description: Answer Assetization is the practice of pre-writing structured, direct, data-rich answers to frequently asked questions and systematically publishing them as an "answer library" for AI to crawl and cite.

item.title: What is AI Visibility Index? — Measuring GEO Performance
item.description: AI Visibility Index is a composite metric for measuring how often a brand is mentioned and cited in AI-generated answers.

item.title: What is YMYL? — Google's High-Standard Content Areas
item.description: YMYL (Your Money or Your Life) designates content areas that can significantly impact users' lives, including healthcare, finance, legal, and safety topics.

item.title: What is GEO? — A Complete Guide to Generative Engine Optimization
item.description: A comprehensive beginner's guide to understanding GEO, its relationship with SEO, and how to get started with Generative Engine Optimization.
